job.job_description:
Role: Legal Engineer
Job Type: Full Time
Job Location: Noida (Onsite)
About the role:
A Legal Engineer bridges the gap between law and technology. This role focuses on building AI-powered solutions that automate legal, compliance, contract management, and regulatory processes. The ideal candidate understands both legal frameworks and modern software technologies.
Requirements:
Education Qualification
Bachelor s / Master s degree in Comp. Sc./Data Science/ AI/ Computational Mathematics/ Statistics or related field, And Law Degree (LLB/LLM).
Added Advantage:
Relevant certifications or notable achievements in public policy, Moot Court, Youth Parliament, debate, legal research, compliance, or interdisciplinary programs.
Required Skills
Experience in LegalTech, ComplianceTech, or legal automation.
Understanding of contracts, compliance, and regulatory frameworks.
Familiarity with AI, NLP, and document intelligence platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work across legal and technical teams.
Responsibilities:
Design and develop AI-powered legal and compliance solutions.
Translate legal requirements into automated workflows and business rules.
Collaborate with legal, product, and engineering teams.
Build contract review, document analysis, and compliance automation tools.
Ensure solutions meet regulatory and data privacy requirements.
Support testing, validation, and continuous improvement of legal AI models.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
